chunks: He has created the heavens and the earth with precision. He folds the day up over the night, and folds the night up over the day. He has subjugated the sun and moon, (so that) each runs its appointed course. Is He not all-mighty and forgiving?

key_terms.يُكَوِّرُ: He folds or wraps around (describing the cyclical motion of day and night)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the creation of the heavens and earth and the cycle of day and night?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'yukawwiru' (wrapping/rolling) is often interpreted as the continuous, dynamic motion of celestial spheres, reflecting a universe in constant flux under divine command. This verse underscores the unity of God's creative act with His sustaining power, linking the physical order of the cosmos to the spiritual reality of resurrection and divine mercy.
